acceptanceCriteria: maxExportEntries and maxExportTotalBytes (and any matching archive verify bound) admit the current repository with headroom; exceeding them still refuses rather than truncates.

TestExportSourceAdmitsCountsAtTheirBounds and TestExportSourceRefusesOversizedEntryCount/TotalBytesBound cover the new bounds; companionrelease package passes, including TestCurrentExportedTasksSmokeGenerator and TestCurrentTasksSourceArchiveBuildsOffline.
public-release-v0.md PUB-V0-012 text and trace row name the new bounds; a build-log entry records the amendment and its growth evidence.
body: CI on batch PR #998 (head 05099e7e6, job 117237422381, 2026-10-16) fails TestCurrentExportedTasksSmokeGenerator and TestCurrentTasksSourceArchiveBuildsOffline: `export entries 10010 exceed bound 10000` (internal/companionrelease/export.go maxExportEntries). origin/main d4b1e2039 is at 9994 entries; batch #999 is at 10009. Growth is ~350 entries/day (5776 on 10-01, 8907 on 10-15), driven by .taskman/tickets (1542), docs/build-log (906), .corvint/changes (820). Total bytes are 113.5 MiB against the 128 MiB maxExportTotalBytes bound, so that bound fails within days too. Every PR adding >=7 files now fails CI. Expected: the bounds admit the repository with headroom; they stay refusals, not truncation. Decision (orchestrator, delegated in-task): raise to 50,000 entries and 512 MiB, amending PUB-V0-012 and public-release-v0.md line 213; keep the archive verify bound consistent.
title: Companion source export refuses the repository: tree passed the 10,000-entry bound (PUB-V0-012); raise entry and byte bounds
